tasks.title: Project Setup and Docker Infrastructure
tasks.description: Initialize Laravel 13 project with all required packages, Docker Compose infrastructure (nginx, php-fpm, mysql, redis, elasticsearch, mailpit, indexer), Makefile commands, and base configuration following stak-be patterns.
tasks.details:
1. Create Laravel 13 project:
```bash
composer create-project laravel/laravel . "^13.0"
```

2. Install required packages:
```bash
composer require tymon/jwt-auth:^2.0 lorisleiva/laravel-actions:^2.8 spatie/laravel-query-builder:^7.3 elastic/elasticsearch-php:^8.0 darkaonline/l5-swagger:^8.6
composer require --dev larastan/larastan:^3.9 laravel/pint:^1.27 mockery/mockery:^1.6
```

3. Create docker-compose.yml with services:
- nginx:alpine on port 8000
- app (php-fpm 8.3) with custom php-fpm.conf
- mysql:8.0 on port 3306
- redis:7-alpine on port 6379 with AOF
- elasticsearch:8.13.4 on port 9200 (single-node, security disabled)
- mailpit on ports 8025/1025
- indexer service (Node.js) depends on redis/elasticsearch

4. Create docker/php-fpm.conf:
```ini
[www]
pm = dynamic
pm.max_children = 20
pm.start_servers = 5
pm.min_spare_servers = 2
pm.max_spare_servers = 8
pm.max_requests = 500
request_terminate_timeout = 30s
slowlog = /var/log/php-fpm/slow.log
request_slowlog_timeout = 3s
```

5. Create docker/php.ini with OPcache:
```ini
opcache.enable = 1
opcache.memory_consumption = 256
opcache.max_accelerated_files = 20000
opcache.validate_timestamps = 1
```

6. Create Dockerfile for PHP app:
```dockerfile
FROM php:8.3-fpm
RUN docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql bcmath
COPY docker/php-fpm.conf /usr/local/etc/php-fpm.d/www.conf
COPY docker/php.ini /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/99-custom.ini
```

7. Create Makefile with targets: up, down, shell, artisan, migrate, seed, fresh, test, pint, phpstan, logs, cache-clear, indexer, es-reindex

8. Configure .env.example with:
- DB_CONNECTION=mysql, DB_HOST=mysql, DB_DATABASE=jobboard
- REDIS_HOST=redis
- ELASTICSEARCH_HOST=elasticsearch:9200
- JWT_SECRET placeholder
- MAIL_MAILER=smtp, MAIL_HOST=mailpit, MAIL_PORT=1025

9. Create nginx/default.conf for PHP-FPM passthrough

10. Publish JWT config: php artisan vendor:publish --provider="Tymon\JWTAuth\Providers\LaravelServiceProvider"

subtasks.title: Create Docker Compose Infrastructure with All Services
subtasks.description: Create docker-compose.yml with nginx, php-fpm app, mysql, redis with AOF, elasticsearch single-node, mailpit, and indexer services with correct ports and dependencies.
subtasks.details:
1. Create docker-compose.yml in project root with all services:

```yaml
version: '3.8'
services:
  nginx:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports: ["8000:80"]
    volumes:
      - ./:/var/www/html
      - ./nginx/default.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
    depends_on: [app]

  app:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    volumes:
      - ./:/var/www/html
    environment:
      - DB_HOST=mysql
      - REDIS_HOST=redis
      - ELASTICSEARCH_HOST=elasticsearch:9200
    depends_on: [mysql, redis]

  mysql:
    image: mysql:8.0
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: jobboard
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: secret
    ports: ["3306:3306"]
    volumes:
      - mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql
      - ./docker/mysql/my.cnf:/etc/mysql/conf.d/my.cnf

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes"]
    ports: ["6379:6379"]
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data

  elasticsearch:
    image: elasticsearch:8.13.4
    environment:
      - discovery.type=single-node
      - xpack.security.enabled=false
      - ES_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms512m -Xmx512m
    ports: ["9200:9200"]
    volumes:
      - es_data:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data

  mailpit:
    image: axllent/mailpit
    ports: ["8025:8025", "1025:1025"]

  indexer:
    build: ./indexer
    command: node index.js
    environment:
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
      - ES_URL=http://elasticsearch:9200
    depends_on: [redis, elasticsearch]

volumes:
  mysql_data:
  redis_data:
  es_data:
```

2. Create nginx/default.conf for PHP-FPM passthrough with fastcgi_pass app:9000 and proper location blocks for / and PHP files.
subtasks.testStrategy:
- Verify all services defined in docker-compose.yml with correct image versions

subtasks.title: Configure PHP-FPM and OPcache with Dockerfile
subtasks.description: Create Dockerfile for PHP 8.3-fpm, docker/php-fpm.conf with pm=dynamic settings, docker/php.ini with OPcache configuration, and MySQL slow query log configuration.
subtasks.details:
1. Create Dockerfile in project root:
```dockerfile
FROM php:8.3-fpm

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    libzip-dev \
    unzip \
    && docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql bcmath zip opcache \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY --from=composer:latest /usr/bin/composer /usr/bin/composer

COPY docker/php-fpm.conf /usr/local/etc/php-fpm.d/www.conf
COPY docker/php.ini /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/99-custom.ini

WORKDIR /var/www/html
```

2. Create docker/php-fpm.conf:
```ini
[www]
pm = dynamic
pm.max_children = 20
pm.start_servers = 5
pm.min_spare_servers = 2
pm.max_spare_servers = 8
pm.max_requests = 500
request_terminate_timeout = 30s
slowlog = /var/log/php-fpm/slow.log
request_slowlog_timeout = 3s
```

3. Create docker/php.ini:
```ini
opcache.enable = 1
opcache.memory_consumption = 256
opcache.max_accelerated_files = 20000
opcache.validate_timestamps = 1

[Date]
date.timezone = UTC
```

4. Create docker/mysql/my.cnf for slow query logging:
```ini
[mysqld]
slow_query_log = 1
slow_query_log_file = /var/log/mysql/slow.log
long_query_time = 0.5
log_queries_not_using_indexes = 1
```

5. Create directory structure: mkdir -p docker/mysql nginx
subtasks.testStrategy:
- Verify Dockerfile builds successfully with `podman build -t jobboard-app .`
- Verify PHP-FPM config has pm=dynamic and pm.max_requests=500
- Verify OPcache enabled with opcache.enable=1
- Verify slow query log configured with long_query_time=0.5
- Verify request_terminate_timeout set to 30s

subtasks.title: Create Makefile with Development Commands
subtasks.description: Create Makefile with all required targets: up, down, shell, artisan, migrate, seed, fresh, test, pint, phpstan, logs, cache-clear, indexer, es-reindex using podman-compose.
subtasks.details:
1. Create Makefile in project root:
```makefile
.PHONY: up down shell artisan migrate seed fresh test pint phpstan logs cache-clear indexer es-reindex

up:
	podman-compose up -d

down:
	podman-compose down

shell:
	podman-compose exec app bash

artisan:
	podman-compose exec app php artisan $(cmd)

migrate:
	podman-compose exec app php artisan migrate

seed:
	podman-compose exec app php artisan db:seed

fresh:
	podman-compose exec app php artisan migrate:fresh --seed

test:
	podman-compose exec app php artisan test

test-coverage:
	podman-compose exec app php artisan test --coverage --min=100

pint:
	podman-compose exec app ./vendor/bin/pint --test

pint-fix:
	podman-compose exec app ./vendor/bin/pint

phpstan:
	podman-compose exec app ./vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=512M

logs:
	podman-compose logs -f

cache-clear:
	podman-compose exec app php artisan cache:clear
	podman-compose exec app php artisan config:clear
	podman-compose exec app php artisan route:clear
	podman-compose exec app php artisan view:clear

indexer:
	podman-compose exec indexer node index.js

es-reindex:
	podman-compose exec app php artisan es:reindex
```

2. Create phpstan.neon for static analysis configuration:
```neon
includes:
    - ./vendor/larastan/larastan/extension.neon

parameters:
    paths:
        - app
    level: 5
    ignoreErrors: []
    checkMissingIterableValueType: false
```

3. Create pint.json for code style configuration (Laravel preset):
```json
{
    "preset": "laravel",
    "rules": {
        "simplified_null_return": true,
        "no_unused_imports": true
    }
}
```

subtasks.title: Create BaseModel and BaseAction Foundation Classes
subtasks.description: Implement the abstract BaseModel extending Eloquent Model with HasFactory trait and guarded id, plus BaseAction using lorisleiva/laravel-actions AsAction trait for common action utilities.
subtasks.details: Create app/Models/BaseModel.php as an abstract class extending Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model with the HasFactory trait. Set protected $guarded = ['id'] to allow mass assignment on all fields except id. All domain models (User, Company, Job, Application) will extend this base. Create app/Actions/BaseAction.php that uses the \Lorisleiva\Actions\Concerns\AsAction trait, providing a consistent base for all action classes. Ensure proper namespace declarations and import statements following PSR-4 autoloading standards.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test verifying BaseModel has $guarded = ['id'] and uses HasFactory trait. Verify BaseAction class exists and uses AsAction trait. Test that a concrete model extending BaseModel inherits the guarded property correctly.

subtasks.title: Create BaseResponse and PaginationResource for API Responses
subtasks.description: Implement BaseResponse utility class with static success(), created(), and noContent() methods, plus PaginationResource wrapping LengthAwarePaginator with snake_case meta keys.
subtasks.details: Create app/Http/Resources/BaseResponse.php with static methods: success(mixed $data = null, int $status = 200, array $meta = []) returning JsonResponse with {success: true, data?, meta?} structure; created(mixed $data = null) calling success with 201; noContent() returning 204 with null body. Create app/Http/Resources/PaginationResource.php wrapping LengthAwarePaginator and exposing meta with snake_case keys: current_page, per_page, total, last_page. All 2xx responses use Content-Type: application/json. Ensure response structure matches stak-be patterns exactly.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test BaseResponse::success() returns JSON with {success: true, data} and 200 status. Test created() returns 201. Test noContent() returns 204. Test PaginationResource wraps paginator with correct meta keys (current_page, per_page, total, last_page) in snake_case.

subtasks.title: Create Custom Exception Classes with RFC 9457 Problem Details
subtasks.description: Implement BaseException with status/type/title properties, and concrete exceptions: NotFoundException (404), ForbiddenException (403), ConflictException (409) following RFC 9457 Problem Details format.
subtasks.details: Create app/Exceptions/BaseException.php extending Exception with protected int $status, string $type, and string $title properties, plus getter methods getStatus(), getType(), getTitle(). Create app/Exceptions/NotFoundException.php extending BaseException with status=404, type='not_found', title='Resource Not Found'. Create app/Exceptions/ForbiddenException.php with status=403, type='forbidden', title='Access Forbidden'. Create app/Exceptions/ConflictException.php with status=409, type='conflict', title='Resource Conflict'. Each accepts optional message in constructor. All exceptions will be rendered as RFC 9457 Problem Details JSON.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test BaseException has getStatus(), getType(), getTitle() methods. Test NotFoundException returns 404 status and 'not_found' type. Test ForbiddenException returns 403 and 'forbidden'. Test ConflictException returns 409 and 'conflict'. Verify custom messages can be passed to constructors.

subtasks.title: Configure Exception Handler for RFC 9457 Problem Details Responses
subtasks.description: Configure bootstrap/app.php withExceptions() to render BaseException and ValidationException as RFC 9457 Problem Details with application/problem+json Content-Type header.
subtasks.details: In bootstrap/app.php, configure withExceptions() callback with two render handlers: 1) For BaseException, return JsonResponse with {type, title, status, instance: request->path()} and Content-Type: application/problem+json header at the exception's status code. 2) For ValidationException, return {type: 'validation_error', title: 'Validation Failed', status: 422, instance: request->path(), errors: e->errors()} with 422 status and application/problem+json header. Import Illuminate\Http\Request, Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException, and App\Exceptions\BaseException. This ensures all 4xx/5xx errors follow RFC 9457 format.
subtasks.testStrategy: Feature test throwing NotFoundException returns 404 with Content-Type: application/problem+json and correct body structure. Test throwing ForbiddenException returns 403 with problem+json. Test ValidationException returns 422 with errors array and problem+json Content-Type. Verify 'instance' field contains the request path.

tasks.title: Database Migrations with Optimized Indexes
tasks.description: Create all database migrations (users, companies, jobs, applications) with the exact schema from the PRD including all composite indexes, foreign keys, and enums. Configure slow query log for development.
tasks.testStrategy:
- Run `make migrate` and verify all tables created
- Verify indexes exist using `SHOW INDEX FROM jobs`
- Test foreign key constraints: delete company cascades jobs
- Test unique constraint: duplicate (job_id, user_id) in applications fails
- Verify composite index order matches query patterns via EXPLAIN
- Test `make fresh` drops and recreates all tables
- Seed test data and verify slow query log captures queries over 500ms

subtasks.title: Create Users Table Migration with Email and Role Indexes
subtasks.description: Create the users table migration with all columns from PRD schema including role enum, email_verified_at, remember_token, and add single-column indexes for email and role columns.
subtasks.details: Create migration file database/migrations/xxxx_create_users_table.php using php artisan make:migration. Define Schema::create('users') with: id (bigint unsigned auto_increment primary key), name (varchar 255 not null), email (varchar 255 unique not null), password (varchar 255 not null), role (enum ['admin','company','candidate'] default 'candidate'), email_verified_at (timestamp nullable), remember_token (varchar 100 nullable), timestamps. Add indexes: $table->index('email', 'idx_email') and $table->index('role', 'idx_role'). Include proper down() method with Schema::dropIfExists('users'). Note: email column already has a unique constraint which creates an index, but idx_email is explicitly added per PRD spec.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run make migrate and verify users table created. Execute SHOW INDEX FROM users to confirm idx_email and idx_role exist. Test unique constraint by attempting duplicate email insert - should fail with integrity violation. Verify role enum only accepts admin/company/candidate values.

subtasks.title: Create Companies Table Migration with Foreign Key and Composite Index
subtasks.description: Create the companies table migration with user_id foreign key cascade delete, all company columns from PRD, and composite index on (industry, country) for common filter queries.
subtasks.details: Create migration database/migrations/xxxx_create_companies_table.php. Define Schema::create('companies') with: id (bigint unsigned pk), user_id (foreignId constrained to users with cascadeOnDelete), name (varchar 255 not null), description (text nullable), industry (varchar 100 nullable), city (varchar 100 nullable), country (varchar 100 default 'ID'), website (varchar 255 nullable), is_verified (boolean default false), timestamps. Add indexes: $table->index('user_id', 'idx_user_id') and $table->index(['industry', 'country'], 'idx_industry_country'). Composite index supports WHERE industry = ? AND country = ? queries. Include down() with Schema::dropIfExists('companies').
subtasks.testStrategy: Run migration and verify companies table exists with correct columns. Test cascade delete: create user with company, delete user, verify company deleted. Execute SHOW INDEX FROM companies to verify idx_user_id and idx_industry_country composite index exist. Verify composite index column order is industry then country.

subtasks.title: Create Jobs Table Migration with All Four Composite Indexes
subtasks.description: Create the jobs table migration with company_id foreign key, employment_type and status enums, all job columns from PRD, and four composite indexes optimized for dashboard, listing, category, and location queries.
subtasks.details: Create migration database/migrations/xxxx_create_jobs_table.php. Define Schema::create('jobs') with: id, company_id (foreignId constrained cascadeOnDelete), title (varchar 255), description (text), category (varchar 100), employment_type (enum ['full_time','part_time','contract','internship']), location_city (varchar 100 nullable), location_country (varchar 100 default 'ID'), is_remote (boolean default false), salary_min (unsignedInteger nullable), salary_max (unsignedInteger nullable), currency (char 3 default 'IDR'), status (enum ['draft','active','closed'] default 'draft'), published_at (timestamp nullable), expires_at (timestamp nullable), timestamps. Add four composite indexes: idx_company_status (company_id, status) for company dashboard, idx_status_published (status, published_at) for active jobs listing, idx_category_status (category, status) for category filter, idx_location_status (location_country, location_city, status) for location filter. Include down() method.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify all composite indexes exist via SHOW INDEX FROM jobs. Test cascade delete: delete company, verify all jobs deleted. Run EXPLAIN on WHERE company_id = ? AND status = ? to verify idx_company_status used (type should be ref, not ALL). Test enum constraints reject invalid values. Verify composite index column order matches PRD specifications.

subtasks.title: Create Applications Table Migration with Unique Constraint and Composite Indexes
subtasks.description: Create the applications table migration with dual foreign keys (job_id, user_id), unique constraint preventing duplicate applications, status enum, and composite indexes for user and job application queries.
subtasks.details: Create migration database/migrations/xxxx_create_applications_table.php. Define Schema::create('applications') with: id, job_id (foreignId constrained cascadeOnDelete), user_id (foreignId constrained cascadeOnDelete), cover_letter (text nullable), status (enum ['pending','reviewed','shortlisted','rejected'] default 'pending'), applied_at (timestamp useCurrent instead of created_at), updated_at (timestamp nullable). Note: this table does NOT use standard timestamps() - applied_at replaces created_at. Add unique constraint: $table->unique(['job_id', 'user_id'], 'uq_job_user') to prevent duplicate applications. Add indexes: idx_user_status (user_id, status) for 'my applications' query, idx_job_status (job_id, status) for 'applications for this job' query. Include down() method.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test unique constraint: insert application, attempt duplicate (same job_id, user_id), verify integrity violation. Test cascade: delete job, verify applications deleted; delete user, verify applications deleted. Run EXPLAIN on WHERE user_id = ? AND status = ? to verify idx_user_status used. Verify applied_at defaults to current timestamp on insert.

subtasks.title: Configure MySQL Slow Query Log and Create Database Factories
subtasks.description: Create MySQL configuration file for slow query logging in development, update docker-compose to mount the config, and create Laravel model factories for User, Company, Job, and Application with proper enum values.
subtasks.details: Create docker/mysql/my.cnf with [mysqld] section containing: slow_query_log = 1, slow_query_log_file = /var/log/mysql/slow.log, long_query_time = 0.5, log_queries_not_using_indexes = 1. Ensure docker-compose.yml mysql service mounts ./docker/mysql/my.cnf:/etc/mysql/conf.d/my.cnf. Create database/factories/UserFactory.php with name, email, password (bcrypt), role (fake()->randomElement(['admin','company','candidate'])). Create database/factories/CompanyFactory.php with user_id, name, description, industry, city, country, website, is_verified. Create database/factories/JobFactory.php with company_id, title, description, category, employment_type (enum values), location_city, location_country, is_remote, salary_min, salary_max, currency, status (enum values), published_at, expires_at. Create database/factories/ApplicationFactory.php with job_id, user_id, cover_letter, status (enum values). Factories should use PHP 8.3 enum values where applicable.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify docker/mysql/my.cnf exists with correct slow_query_log settings. Restart mysql container and verify config applied via SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'slow_query_log'. subtasks.title: Install and Configure tymon/jwt-auth Package
subtasks.description: Install tymon/jwt-auth via Composer, publish config, configure config/jwt.php with HS256 algorithm, TTL settings, and required claims. Generate JWT secret and configure config/auth.php with API guard.
subtasks.details:
1. Run `composer require tymon/jwt-auth` to install the package.
2. Publish config: `php artisan vendor:publish --provider="Tymon\JWTAuth\Providers\LaravelServiceProvider"`.
3. Generate JWT secret: `php artisan jwt:secret`.
4. Configure config/jwt.php:
   - `'algo' => 'HS256'` (never accept alg: none)
   - `'ttl' => 60` (minutes)
   - `'refresh_ttl' => 20160` (2 weeks)
   - `'required_claims' => ['iss', 'sub', 'aud', 'jti', 'iat', 'exp']`
5. Update config/auth.php to add 'api' guard:
   ```php
   'guards' => [
       'api' => [
           'driver' => 'jwt',
           'provider' => 'users',
       ],
   ],
   ```
6. Update User model to implement JWTSubject interface with getJWTIdentifier() and getJWTCustomClaims() methods (include roles in custom claims).
7. Add role column to users table via migration and create UserRole enum.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit test config values are correctly set. Feature test that JWT tokens are generated with HS256 algorithm and contain required claims (iss, sub, aud, jti, iat, exp, roles). Verify JWT_SECRET is set in .env.

tasks.title: API Documentation with Swagger/OpenAPI

tasks.details:
1. Publish Swagger config:
```bash
php artisan vendor:publish --provider="L5Swagger\L5SwaggerServiceProvider"
```

2. Configure config/l5-swagger.php:
```php
'documentations' => [
    'default' => [
        'api' => [
            'title' => 'JobBoard API',
            'description' => 'Laravel 13 Job Board REST API with Elasticsearch',
            'version' => '1.0.0',
        ],
        'routes' => [
            'api' => 'api/documentation',
        ],
        'paths' => [
            'docs' => storage_path('api-docs'),
            'annotations' => [base_path('app')],
        ],
    ],
],
'security' => [
    'Bearer' => [
        'type' => 'http',
        'scheme' => 'bearer',
        'bearerFormat' => 'JWT',
    ],
],
```

3. Add base annotations to app/Http/Controllers/Controller.php:
```php
/**
 * @OA\Info(
 *     title="JobBoard API",
 *     version="1.0.0",
 *     description="Laravel 13 Job Board REST API"
 * )
 * @OA\Server(url="http://localhost:8000/api/v1")
 * @OA\SecurityScheme(

 *     type="http",
 *     scheme="bearer",
 *     bearerFormat="JWT"
 * )
 */
```

```php
/**
 * @OA\Get(
 *     path="/jobs",
 *     summary="Search jobs via Elasticsearch",
 *     tags={"Jobs"},
 *     @OA\Parameter(name="q", in="query", description="Full-text search query"),

 *     @OA\Response(
 *         response=200,
 *         description="Success",
 *         @OA\JsonContent(ref="#/components/schemas/JobSearchResponse")
 *     )
 * )
 */
```

5. Define schemas for resources, requests, and responses

7. Add Makefile target:
```makefile
swagger:
	podman-compose exec app php artisan l5-swagger:generate
```
